H7_AURA_CLEANSING_H7C.description:
{Cleansing Aura}
Defense +${val}; removes one harmful spell at the start of each round.

H7_AURA_PURITY_H7C.description:
{Aura of Purity}
Cannot be targeted by harmful spells.

H7_AURA_HEARTDARK_H7C.description:
{Heart of Darkness}
Light spell damage taken -${val}%.

H7_AURA_SHIELD_H7C.description:
{Raise Shields}
Attack damage taken -${val}%; an adjacent Legionnaire takes the same amount.

H7_AURA_SOULFIRE_H7C.description:
{Soulfire}
Morale +1, Speed +${val} until the end of its next action.

H7_AURA_FIRE_H7C.description:
{Fire Aura}
Immune to harmful Earth spells.

H7_DEFENSIVE_H7C.description:
{Defensive Stance}
Unlimited retaliations, immune to flank and rear attacks until its next action.

H7_NO_FLANK_H7C.description:
{Vigilance}
Immune to flank and rear attacks.

H7_SEA_WARFARE_H7C.description:
{Naval Warfare}
On water: Speed +2, Hit Points +3, Attack +6, Defense +6, Damage +3

valueDescriptions.20:
{Rooted}
Cannot move or use movement-related abilities.
valueDescriptions.21:
{Entangling Roots}
Cannot move or use movement abilities until the Ancient Treant moves or dies.
valueDescriptions.22:
{Bound}
Cannot move until the Kraken's next action, or until it leaves or dies.

H7_INCAP_H7C.description:
{Incapacitated}
Cannot act or retaliate until the end of its next action.

H7_INCAP_FRAGILE_H7C.description:
{Incapacitated}
Cannot act or retaliate until its next action ends; taking damage breaks it.

H7_ACID_H7C.description:
{Acid}
Takes ${val} Earth damage at round start, halving each round.

H7_WITHER_H7C.description:
{Blighting Breath}
Takes ${val} Dark damage at round start, halving each round.

H7_VENOM_H7C.description:
{Blighting Venom}
Takes ${val} Dark damage at round start, rising each round.

H7_BLADES_H7C.description:
{Poisoned Blades}
Takes ${val} Dark damage at round start, rising each round.

H7_CORRODE_H7C.description:
{Corrosive Venom}
Defense -${val} until the end of its next action.

H7_BLOODRAGE_H7C.description:
{Blood Rage}
With a hero: +6 Attack at battle start, -2 each round and on wait or defend

H7_WILD_H7C.description:
{Wild}
Every attack strikes twice until its next action ends.

H7_RAGE_H7C.description:
{Fury}
Until its next action ends: damage +${val}, Speed +2, immune to Mind spells.

H7_MAGIC_ABSORB_H7C.description:
{Absorb Magic}
Next attack deals ${val} extra Prime damage.

H7_MANA_CREDIT_H7C.description:
{Drained Mana}
Your hero's spells cost ${val} less mana this round.

H7_RUNE_CARRY_H7C.description:
{Rune of Balance Aura}
It and the allies around it share attack damage evenly until the battle ends.

H7_SHELTER_H7C.description:
{Living Shelter}
Defense +${val}; adjacent empty hexes block enemies until it moves or attacks.

H7_NOVA_ARMED_H7C.description:
{Nova}
This shot hits every unit in the 3x3 area around the target.

H7_SCATTER_ARMED_H7C.description:
{Scatter Shot}
This shot hits every unit in the 3x3 area around the target for half damage.

H7_HAMMER_ARMED_H7C.description:
{Throwing Hammer}
This shot: Attack +7, no range penalty.

H7_LEAF_ARMED_H7C.description:
{Leaf Daggers}
This shot pierces enemies in a line, ignoring Defense, range and walls.

H7_IMPLODE_ARMED_H7C.description:
{Imploding Arrow}
On hit, units within 3 hexes are pulled 1 hex toward the target.

H7_INK_ARMED_H7C.description:
{Ink Spray}
This melee hits the target and the enemies beside it; inked units deal half damage.

H7_STING_ARMED_H7C.description:
{Maiming Sting}
This melee deals half damage and draws no retaliation; the target cannot retaliate.

H7_POUNCE_SHOW_H7C.description:
{Mighty Pounce}
This strike hits all adjacent enemies, no retaliation.

H7_INKED_H7C.description:
{Ink Spray}
Melee and retaliation damage halved until the end of next round.

H7_CRIPPLED_H7C.description:
{Maiming Sting}
Cannot retaliate until the end of next round.

H7_NECRO_RAISE_H7C.description:
{H7 Necromancy}
With 4+ stacks of H7 undead, Necromancy raises their H7 counterparts.

H7_RUNE_INFO_H7C.description:
{Rune Stone}
A rune stone called forth by the H7 Memorial runes.

H7_RUNE_RADIANT_H7C.description:
{Rune of Radiance}
Aura effects tripled until the end of next round.
